# Youth Environment Society (YES)
> A youth-led environmental organization in Azerbaijan empowering the next generation of ecological advocates.

## About YES
Youth Environment Society (YES) is a non-profit, youth-led organization based in Azerbaijan.
Our mission is to protect the environment and inspire young people to become active environmental leaders.
We were founded in 2026 and operate primarily in Azerbaijan, with a growing community of 180+ members.

YES believes that meaningful change starts with young people. We create an environment where youth can learn, grow, and take real action for the planet.

## What We Do
YES operates across three core pillars:

- **Environment**: Protecting ecosystems, reducing waste, and advocating for clean air, water, and land.
- **Youth**: Educating, inspiring, and mobilizing young people to become confident voices for our planet.
- **Action**: Running campaigns, clean-up events, and educational initiatives that create measurable, tangible impact.

## Volunteer Program
YES offers a free volunteer program open to all youth in Azerbaijan.
Volunteers gain hands-on experience and benefits including:

- **Build Your Network** — Connect with like-minded young activists, mentors, and environmental leaders across Azerbaijan and beyond.
- **Gain Real Experience** — Develop practical skills in project management, public speaking, research, and environmental advocacy.
- **Create Real Impact** — Participate in campaigns, clean-ups, and educational events that leave a measurable mark on your community.
- **Grow as a Leader** — Take on responsibilities, lead initiatives, and discover your potential as a young champion for sustainability.

Registration is free and takes approximately 2 minutes via our website.
Note: The volunteer program registration period is currently closed. Applications for the next cycle will be announced on our social media channels.

## Member Dashboard
YES members have access to a personal dashboard at https://youthensoc.org/dashboard.html where they can:
- View their profile and volunteer status
- Browse active events and opportunities
- Access shared documents and resources
- Receive notifications from the YES team

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is YES?**
YES (Youth Environment Society) is a youth-led environmental organization in Azerbaijan dedicated to empowering young people through environmental education, community organizing, and direct action. It was founded in 2026.

**How do I join YES?**
Sign up for free at https://youthensoc.org/#join. It takes only 2 minutes and is open to all youth in Azerbaijan.

**Is the program free?**
Yes. All YES programs and the volunteer program are completely free to join.

**What kind of activities does YES organize?**
YES organizes environmental clean-ups, educational workshops, awareness campaigns, community events, and youth leadership programs focused on sustainability and ecology.

**How large is the YES community?**
As of 2026, YES has a community of 180+ members across Azerbaijan.

**Does YES have an app or member portal?**
YES has a web-based personal dashboard at https://youthensoc.org/dashboard.html where registered members can log in to manage their profile, access resources, and receive announcements.

**What languages does YES operate in?**
YES operates in both Azerbaijani and English. The website, articles, and communications are available in both languages.

**Where can I follow YES for updates?**
Follow YES on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/youthensoc
Follow YES on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/youth-environment-society-yes/
